classification.difficultyReason: Scaffolded stadium areas: the radius comes from the labelled height, then the inner area is subtracted. Parts a and b are signposted.

content.prompt: The cycling track shown needs to be resurfaced.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Find the area of the outer oval, in terms of $\pi$.

answer.worked:
The outer oval is a rectangle with two semicircles that form one circle of radius $\frac{16}{2}=8$ m.
$$\begin{align*}A_{\text{outer}}&=30\times16+\pi(8)^2\\A_{\text{outer}}&=480+64\pi\ \mathrm{m}^2\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find the area of the inner oval, in terms of $\pi$.

answer.worked:
The inner oval is a rectangle with two semicircles that form one circle of radius $\frac{10}{2}=5$ m.
$$\begin{align*}A_{\text{inner}}&=30\times10+\pi(5)^2\\A_{\text{inner}}&=300+25\pi\ \mathrm{m}^2\end{align*}$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: Calculate the area to be resurfaced to 2 decimal places.
